about: Typical interview focus by company type: an ESTIMATE from common public interview reports (round structures, frequently reported question themes), not data about any single company. Teams differ; check recent reports for the exact team before you apply. Edit this file to tune it: weights split readiness between DSA, HLD, LLD and AI; pattern emphasis 3 = asked a lot, 2 = often, 1 = sometimes (every other plan pattern counts as 1); hld / lld / ai list the roadmap levels that matter most.

profiles.label: Trading & quant
profiles.rounds: hard DSA + maths/probability puzzles, low-level and concurrency questions

profiles.label: Fintech & banking tech
profiles.rounds: DSA (medium), machine coding / LLD, system design with consistency and payments

profiles.label: Consumer product (e-commerce, travel, mobility, media…)
profiles.rounds: DSA (medium), a machine-coding round, system design for senior-ish roles

profiles.label: SaaS, infra, data & dev tools
profiles.rounds: DSA (medium), distributed-systems heavy design, debugging / code review

profiles.label: AI & semiconductors
profiles.rounds: DSA (medium), ML/LLM fundamentals and a practical AI build, some system design

profiles.label: Health, ed, telecom & engineering services
profiles.rounds: DSA (easy–medium), OOP / LLD, basic system design, project deep-dive

profiles.label: Remote-first (global)
profiles.rounds: practical: take-home or pair programming, system design, async communication
